The whole pool (up to 40 movies) in the order the admin set, neither randomized nor limited: the frontend picks the day’s subset itself. Movies without a poster, or blocked from the catalogue, are omitted. An empty pool is a valid answer.

Same as GET /curations/landing-grid plus updatedBy, but nothing is hidden: movies without a poster or image are returned so they can be fixed.
Requires role: admin.

put.description:
Saves the list in one transaction: all of it or none. 400 for a slot outside 0–26, a repeated slot, an imageUrl that is neither an https:// URL nor a path starting with /, or an objectPosition over 40 characters. 422 when a movieId is not in the library (the message names the ids). Returns the stored grid like GET /admin/curations/landing-grid.
Requires role: admin.

get.description:
Same as GET /curations/editors-picks plus updatedBy, but nothing is hidden: movies that lost their poster since they were picked are returned so they can be replaced.
Requires role: admin.
get.summary: The editors' picks pool as stored, for editing.

put.description:
Saves the list in one transaction: all of it or none. The order of items becomes the display order, and an item's imageUrl (a TMDb image from GET /admin/curations/movies/{movieId}/posters) replaces the movie poster as that pick's cover. Send items or the deprecated movieIds (which resets every cover to the poster), not both. 400 for more than 40 picks, a repeated movie, a bad movieId or an imageUrl that is not a TMDb image URL. 422 when a movie is not in the library (the message names the ids) or has neither a poster nor an imageUrl. Returns the stored pool like GET /admin/curations/editors-picks.
Requires role: admin.
put.summary: Replace the whole editors' picks pool.

get.description:
Every poster TMDb has for a library movie (English or textless), best rated first, at most 30. Each has imageUrl, ready to save as a pick's imageUrl, and a small thumbnailUrl for the picker. isDefault marks the movie's current poster. movieId is the library id (Movie.id). 404 when the movie is not in the library; an empty list for a movie that did not come from TMDb. 502/504 when TMDb is unreachable.
Requires role: admin.
get.summary: TMDb posters to choose a pick cover from.

boost.description: Multiplies the person’s chance of being picked: 0 never, 1 normal. Outside 0–10 is rejected with 422.

blocked.description: Never auto-picked. Manual scheduling still works.

note.description: Why. An empty string clears it. Longer than 500 characters is rejected with 422.

slot.description: Grid cell index, row-major in the frontend grid. Unique within the request. Outside 0–26 is rejected with 400.

movieId.description: Library movie id (Movie.id, not the TMDb id). The same movie may fill several slots. An id that is not in the library is rejected with 422.

imageUrl.description: Hand-graded image for this cell: an absolute https:// URL (for example from POST /uploads/file) or a site-relative path starting with /. Omitted, null or blank: the frontend falls back to the movie poster. Anything else is rejected with 400.

objectPosition.description: CSS object-position for the image, such as "center 35%". Omitted, null or blank: the frontend default. Longer than 40 characters is rejected with 400.

items.description: The whole grid. Slots left out become empty; an empty array clears the grid. Replaces the stored list in one transaction.

movieId.description: Library movie id (Movie.id, not the TMDb id). Each movie can be a pick once.

imageUrl.description: Cover shown for this pick instead of the movie poster: a TMDb image URL, as offered by GET /admin/curations/movies/{movieId}/posters. Omitted, null or blank: the movie poster. Any other URL is rejected with 400.

items.description: The whole pool in display order, each pick with an optional cover image. No repeated movie (400); more than 40 is rejected with 400; an unknown movie with 422; a movie with neither a poster nor an imageUrl with 422. An empty array clears the pool. Replaces the stored list in one transaction. Send this or movieIds, not both (400).

movieIds.description: Deprecated, use items. The whole pool of library movie ids (Movie.id) in display order, every pick on its movie poster: saving this clears any cover images. Same rules as items.
